title: Preview: Dinner’s On Me with Guest Josh Radnor

sentences.en: Hey, it's Josh.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是乔什。

sentences.en: Recently, I appeared on a great podcast,
sentences.zh: 最近，我上了一个很棒的播客节目，

sentences.en: Dinner's On Me, with Jesse Tyler Ferguson.
sentences.zh: 杰西·泰勒·弗格森主持的《Dinner's On Me》。

sentences.en: Jesse and I have known each other for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 我和杰西认识很长时间了。

sentences.en: We have a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多共同点。

sentences.en: We were both on hit sitcoms at this very specific time.
sentences.zh: 我们在那个特定的时期都演过热门情景喜剧。

sentences.en: We're around
sentences.zh: 我们年纪

sentences.en: the same age, but we hadn't really ever sat down and talked about the weirdness of being on a long
sentences.zh: 相仿，但我们以前真的从来没有坐下来聊聊，在一个热播长寿节目里

sentences.en: running hit show for as long as we were.
sentences.zh: 演那么久是一种怎样的奇异体验。

sentences.en: We ate at a restaurant in Fort Greene, Brooklyn called
sentences.zh: 我们在布鲁克林格林堡的一家餐厅吃了饭，

sentences.en: Evelina.
sentences.zh: 名叫埃韦利娜。

sentences.en: And if you're a fan of our show, you will likely love Dinner's On Me because he has a lot of
sentences.zh: 如果你是我们节目的粉丝，你很可能会喜欢《Dinner's On Me》，因为他邀请了很多

sentences.en: people on that have appeared on your favorite TV shows from Lisa Kudrow to Tracy Ellis Ross to
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的电视剧演员上节目，从丽莎·库卓到特雷西·埃利斯·罗斯，

sentences.en: Joshua Jackson to the Ed O'Neill.
sentences.zh: 再到约书亚·杰克逊以及艾德·奥尼尔。

sentences.en: Now, being recorded during a meal means you'll truly feel
sentences.zh: 由于是在用餐期间录制的，这意味着你真的会感觉

sentences.en: like a fly on the wall.
sentences.zh: 自己像个旁观者。

sentences.en: There's the ambient sound of the restaurant, conversation with the server.
sentences.zh: 有餐厅的环境音，还有和服务员的对话。

sentences.en: You get to hear what people drink and how they take their coffee.
sentences.zh: 你能听到人们喝什么，咖啡加什么。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm curious about that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我对这些挺好奇的。

sentences.en: I
sentences.zh: 我

sentences.en: don't know if you are.
sentences.zh: 不知道你是不是也这样。

sentences.en: And A Good Meal does let some walls down, and you'll hear our unguarded
sentences.zh: 一顿美食确实能让人卸下防备，你会听到我们毫无保留的

sentences.en: conversation about everything from imposter syndrome to parenting to coping after loss.
sentences.zh: 对话，内容无所不包，从冒名顶替综合征到为人父母，再到痛失亲人后的应对方式。

sentences.en: For me, I got
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我有机会

sentences.en: to talk about my evolving relationship with the character I played on How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 谈谈我对自己在《老爸老妈浪漫史》中扮演的角色的不断变化的看法。

sentences.en: And we got to commiserate and share about a really crazy, wonderful time in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们得以共同感慨并分享我们生活中一段非常疯狂而美好的时光。

sentences.en: Actually, let's hear a bit of that conversation right now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们现在就来听听那段对话的一部分。

sentences.en: When you were starting off your career, I mean, you've conquered so many different—I don't
sentences.zh: 当你刚开始职业生涯的时候，我是说，你征服了那么多不同的——我不知道

sentences.en: know if I've conquered the right word, but you have found success and traction in so many
sentences.zh: “征服”这个词准不准，但你在音乐、写作和导演等行业的

sentences.en: different facets of this industry with music and with writing and directing.
sentences.zh: 这么多不同领域都获得了成功并打响了名气。

sentences.en: I love your
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你的

sentences.en: movies, Josh.
sentences.zh: 电影，乔什。

sentences.en: Oh, thanks, man.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢了，兄弟。

sentences.en: I'm really—that's mostly what I'm wanting to do.
sentences.zh: 我真的——那基本上是我现在最想做的事。

sentences.en: I mean, I think you're a great director.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得你是个很棒的导演。

sentences.en: You're a fantastic writer.
sentences.zh: 你是个出色的作家。

sentences.en: I'm in awe of the fact that
sentences.zh: 我感到佩服的是，

sentences.en: you have not only written and directed, but also starred in those filMs.
sentences.zh: 你不仅自编自导，还亲自主演了那些电影。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't want to do that again.
sentences.zh: 对，我可不想再那样做了。

sentences.en: I was—I can only imagine that much being incredibly difficult.
sentences.zh: 我当时——我只能想象那有多么困难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But when you were starting off your career, did you have a game plan, or did you have
sentences.zh: 但当你刚开始职业生涯时，你有什么全盘计划，或者说你对

sentences.en: an idea of what success looked like?
sentences.zh: 成功有过什么构想吗？

sentences.en: I mean, did you know where you wanted to land?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道自己想在哪里落脚吗？

sentences.en: Was what
sentences.zh: 你

sentences.en: you created, is this what you imagined?
sentences.zh: 所创造的一切，就是你想象中的样子吗？

sentences.en: That's such a great question.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题。

sentences.en: You know, for years I told a story about myself that I realized
sentences.zh: 你知道，多年来我一直向别人讲述一个关于我自己的故事，后来我意识到

sentences.en: was a bit of a lie.
sentences.zh: 那其实有点谎言的成分。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And the story was, I wanted to be a theater actor in New York who, like, did the occasional
sentences.zh: 当时的故事是，我只想在纽约做一个戏剧演员，偶尔

sentences.en: law and order, but was just really committed to the theater above all things.
sentences.zh: 客串一下《法律与秩序》，但最热爱的绝对还是戏剧。

sentences.en: And then
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: I found these journals that I had written and, like, little pep talks to myself.
sentences.zh: 我找到了自己以前写的日记，里面还有写给自己的各种小鼓励。

sentences.en: And I actually
sentences.zh: 而实际上

sentences.en: was envisioning a bigger career, bigger meaning by coastal that involved TV and film, just
sentences.zh: 我当时设想的是更大的事业、更有意义的、涉及电视和电影的东西，两边兼顾

sentences.en: more varied.
sentences.zh: 而且更加丰富多元。

sentences.en: I don't mean—I think the theater's, like, the beSt. But I did have my eye on the
sentences.zh: 我不是说——我觉得戏剧才是最棒的。但我确实比自己承认的要更有

sentences.en: prize a little bit more than I—but I had this story.
sentences.zh: 野心一点——不过我当时编造了那个故事。

sentences.en: I think it's being from the Midwest
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是因为来自中西部

sentences.en: is a very, like, don't brag, don't—you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 有一种，你知道的，别吹牛、别显摆的文化，懂我的意思吗？

sentences.en: And I've struggled with some of
sentences.zh: 我在某种程度上也一直在

sentences.en: that through my—
sentences.zh: 跟这种心态作斗争——

sentences.en: Where'd you go up again?
sentences.zh: 你老家到底是哪儿来着？

sentences.en: Columbus, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州哥伦布市。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But it's got a kind of tall poppy thing going.
sentences.zh: 但那里有一种“出头鸟”会被打压的氛围。

sentences.en: So I think I had to—I felt like I had to
sentences.zh: 所以我当时觉得——我必须

sentences.en: disguise my ambition.
sentences.zh: 掩饰自己的野心。

sentences.en: But I was—I remember when I did my Broadway debut, I took over for
sentences.zh: 但我当时——我记得我完成百老汇首秀时，我接替了

sentences.en: Jason Biggs for a couple months and The Graduate, Kathleen Turner.
sentences.zh: 杰森·比格斯出演《毕业生》几个月，搭档凯瑟琳·特纳。

sentences.en: And they wanted me to come back
sentences.zh: 他们后来想让我回去

sentences.en: and take over the role.
sentences.zh: 继续接演这个角色。

sentences.en: And I told someone, I can't do this because I gotta go out to LA
sentences.zh: 我对某个人说，我不能演这个，因为我得去洛杉矶

sentences.en: and do a—get a hit TV show so I can do all the theater I want.
sentences.zh: 拍一部大热电视剧，这样我以后就能随心所欲地演戏剧了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like, I had this idea—and I think some of it was from—because I went to NYU to the grad acting program—and
sentences.zh: 我就有这种想法——我想这部分是因为——因为我去了纽约大学读表演研究生——

sentences.en: there was this bulletin board, like the alumni board, you know, where they put up, like, what the alumni
sentences.zh: 那里有一个布告栏，类似于校友栏，你知道的，上面会贴出校友们

sentences.en: are doing in the world.
sentences.zh: 在业界的发展情况。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's reviews, and good reviews are highlighted, and profiles on people in all
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，上面有各种评论，好评会被标出来，还有各种杂志上

sentences.en: these magazines.
sentences.zh: 对人物的专访。

sentences.en: And I would stare at it, and I was just like, am I gonna be on that board?
sentences.zh: 我经常盯着它看，心想，我会出现在那个公告栏上吗？

sentences.en: Like, am I gonna be up there?
sentences.zh: 就是，我能上榜吗？

sentences.en: You know, because I wanted my training to have—be fruitful.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为我希望我的专业训练能——能有所收获。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: You know, I wanted—
sentences.zh: 你知道，我希望——

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，当然。

sentences.en: I wanted a good career.
sentences.zh: 我想要一份好的事业。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道。

sentences.en: I think that, yes, I wanted to be on a big TV
sentences.zh: 我觉得，是的，我想参演一部大热的电视

sentences.en: show.
sentences.zh: 节目。

sentences.en: I wanted—I even said this to myself—I wanna be on a primetime show.
sentences.zh: 我想——我甚至对自己说过——我想演黄金档的节目。

sentences.en: I wanna be the
sentences.zh: 我想当

sentences.en: lead.
sentences.zh: 主角。

sentences.en: I want it to be generationally, like, defining.
sentences.zh: 我希望这部剧能成为具有时代意义的那种作品。

sentences.en: I want the people who created it
sentences.zh: 我希望创作者

sentences.en: to have never done a big hit show before because I think it's kind of lightning in a bottle.
sentences.zh: 以前从未制作过大热剧集，因为我觉得那就像是可遇不可求的奇迹。

sentences.en: Like, there were all these weird things that I kind of, like, put on my little wish list
sentences.zh: 就像，我把各种奇怪的要求都写在了自己的小愿望清单上

sentences.en: that came true.
sentences.zh: 而它们居然都实现了。

sentences.zh: 多年以后，我看着那个，我意识到我忘了说——而且

sentences.zh: 我现在向宇宙下订单时总是会这样说——我忘了说，我

sentences.en: want to enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 想要享受它。

sentences.en: Because it took me a while to learn how to enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 因为我花了很长时间才学会如何去享受它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: To hear my full chat with Jesse in all its glory, please head to Dinners On Me.
sentences.zh: 想完整收听我和杰西的精彩访谈，请前往《Dinners On Me》。
